title: 第19章 风之力风轨第20章 星尘魔器
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 热空气翻过了重重山岭，席卷了这片南方的春意黯然，换上了夏季的山凉云蒸。
紧随其后，又是毫无征兆的一场大雨扑打，残叶、落花遍地凋零！
博城是一个还算有季节的城市，但有的时候也是极度任性。
就早上那会，烈阳高照，万里无云，刚睡了一个午觉简直就跟穿越了一般，狂风作怪，乌云密布。再到傍晚那会，暴雨冰冷、狂风凛冽！
“是不是台风要来了啊，这鬼天气……真就一年四季随机播，想到哪季就哪季的节奏！”宿舍里，张小侯抱怨了起来。
“张小侯，你不是风系的吗，来，到外面大风的地方试试，看看能不能把风系的初阶技能-风轨给释放出来。”同宿舍的陆小斌说道。
“你他妈还水系的，怎么不见你去来一个水域，堂堂水系魔法师，出门你还打伞，说出去不怕丢人？”莫凡劈头盖脸的就把陆小斌这家伙给骂了一顿。
陆小斌脸上一阵青一阵白。
确实啊，水系魔法师大雨天就应该一件风衣，在天地一色中孤傲穿行，滴水不沾。
问题是，都快到年度考核了，他陆小斌也就掌控4颗星子，离释放水系技能-水御还远着呢！
“张小侯，你真的能用风轨了吗，给哥几个展示一下吧，说实话我们除了见周敏那暴力女把火滋给用出来，还没有见过班里谁完整的使用过魔法了。”成天嘴上各种意|淫唐月老师的宿舍舍长说道。
“不太好吧，我也不是百分百成功。”张小侯略显腼腆的说道。
“猴子，来一个吧，我也想看看风系技能是怎么样的。”莫凡眼睛一亮，放下了手头上的理论书。
“空间太小。”
“走廊啊，走廊长着。”
“好……好吧，我试试，不过我真的不是很熟练。”张小侯点了点头。
已经到了学期末，张小侯这小子倒是很有天赋，已经是班级里少数掌握七颗星子的人了。
大家对每一系技能都很好奇，自然想看看张小侯施展得怎么样。
张小侯闭上了眼睛，开始进入到释放状态。
他的起势非常慢，显然星子的把控确实不是很娴熟。
他保持着呼吸节奏，每一次呼吸都可以听到鼻息。
突然，桌子上的书出现了翻动。
宿舍那老旧的门咯吱咯吱乱响了起来。
地上的灰尘扬起，还卷起了一条藏在床底下的脏三角裤，宿舍老大刚要去抓，这小三角裤一个风骚的走位躲开了去，在风中潇洒飘摇！
“风轨?疾行！”
张小侯整个人气质都变了，眼睛呈现青色，衣襟狂躁的舞动着。
随着他一声念下，霎时宿舍那些牙刷、杯子、一架哐当乱撞，全部朝着某个指定的轨迹挪动。
莫凡急忙定神凝视，从这些碎碎的杂物和扬起的灰尘，他惊讶的发现宿舍里出现了一条很特殊的气流轨道，这条轨道从张小侯位置起始，延伸到了走廊一直到走廊尽头的公共厕所！
突然，张小侯身影一阵虚晃。
刚才还静止在宿舍中央的张小侯整个人跟施展了凌波微步一般，速度飙快的冲出了宿舍并且顺着那条空气中若隐若现的风之轨迹朝着走廊尽头的厕所狂驰！
“吊爆了！！”陆小斌大叫了一声。
宿舍一群人顿时挤出了门，追着张小候望去。
然而，就大家刚走出宿舍这一会，张小候已经从整个走廊的最左端极速挪到了最尽头。
太快了！
什么百米冲刺飞人在这移动速度满前都弱爆了！
content_en:
The hot air passed over the mountains and swept over the southern part of the country. The spring breeze was replaced by the coolness of the mountains in summer.
Immediately afterwards, there was another heavy rain without warning, and the remaining leaves and fallen flowers withered everywhere!
Bo is a city with seasons, but sometimes it can be extremely willful.
At that moment in the morning, the sun was shining brightly and there were no clouds in the sky. It was like I had just taken a nap and it was like traveling back in time. The wind was blowing hard and the clouds were thick. Then in the evening, the rainstorm was freezing and the wind was blowing!
"Is there a typhoon coming? This crazy weather... it's really random all year round, and I just follow the rhythm of whatever season comes to mind!" Zhang Xiaohou complained in the dormitory.
"Zhang Xiaohou, aren't you from the wind element? Come on, go outside to a windy place and try to see if you can unleash the wind element's primary skill - Wind Track." Lu Xiaobin, who lives in the same dormitory, said.
"You're a damn water magician. Why don't you go to a water body? You're a water magician. You hold an umbrella when you go out. Are you afraid of being embarrassed if you go out?" Mo Fan scolded Lu Xiaobin right away.
Lu Xiaobin's face turned blue and white.
Indeed, a water magician should wear a windbreaker on a rainy day, so that he can walk proudly in the same color of heaven and earth without dripping water.
The problem is, it's almost the annual assessment, and Lu Xiaobin can only control 4 stars, and he is still far away from unleashing the water skill - Water Taming!
"Zhang Xiaohou, can you really use the wind rail? Show it to the brothers. To be honest, apart from seeing Zhou Min, that violent girl, use the fire, we have never seen anyone in the class use magic completely." said the dormitory principal who said all kinds of obscene things about Teacher Tang Yue all day long.
"Not so good, I'm not 100% successful either." Zhang Xiaohou said shyly.
"Monkey, come here, I also want to see what the wind skills are like." Mo Fan's eyes lit up and he put down the theory book on his hand.
“The space is too small.”
"The corridor is long."
"Okay... okay, I'll give it a try, but I'm really not very skilled." Zhang Xiaohou nodded.
It was already the end of the semester, and Zhang Xiaohou was very talented. He was already one of the few people in the class who could master the seven stars.
Everyone is very curious about each series of skills, and naturally wants to see how Zhang Xiaohou performs them.
Zhang Xiaohou closed his eyes and began to enter a state of release.
His start was very slow, and it was obvious that Xingzi's control was not very skillful.
He kept up his breathing rhythm and could hear his breath with each breath.
"Huh huh hu~~~~~~"
Suddenly, the books on the table were flipped.
The old dormitory door creaked.
The dust on the ground rose, and a pair of dirty briefs hidden under the bed rolled up. Just as the boss of the dormitory was about to grab it, the little briefs moved out of the way in a coquettish way, swaying gracefully in the wind!
"Wind track? Speedy!"
Zhang Xiaohou's whole demeanor changed, his eyes turned blue, and his clothes were dancing manically.
As he read this, all the toothbrushes, cups, and racks in the dormitory clattered and moved towards a certain designated trajectory.
Mo Fan hurriedly focused his attention. From these broken debris and raised dust, he was surprised to find a very special airflow track in the dormitory. This track started from Zhang Xiaohou's position and extended to the corridor to the public toilet at the end of the corridor!
"Whoosh!!"
Suddenly, Zhang Xiaohou's figure fainted.
Zhang Xiaohou, who was still in the middle of the dormitory just now, rushed out of the dormitory as fast as if he had used Lingbo Microstep, and followed the wind trail looming in the air towards the toilet at the end of the corridor!
"It's crazy!!" Lu Xiaobin shouted.
A group of people in the dormitory immediately squeezed out of the door and looked after Zhang Xiaohou.
However, as soon as everyone walked out of the dormitory, Zhang Xiaohou had already moved very quickly from the left end of the entire corridor to the end.
Too fast!
Any 100-meter sprinter would be too weak to move at full speed!
